purpose: Each criterion of US-19905 driven through bin/rcf.js as a child process: rcf audit test-strength over a scratch copy of the committed fixture test/fixtures/py-strength/ (a small Python project whose node:test tests run the Python through python3) laid over a project made by the bin's own rcf init and committed to git, under a PATH of one scratch directory with the host's python3, none, a shim that reports 3.8.18 or a shim that gives no version; and rcf define validate over a project holding a Python def and class.
title: Python sources in the test-strength audit and the Python def anchor through bin/rcf.js

testCases.description: AC-101-1 claiming the top-level def src/paths.py#canonical and AC-101-2 the class src/config.py#Config, bound to node:test tests that run the Python through python3, exits 0 with "test-strength: PASS 2 criteria at <h7>: structural 2/2, mutants killed 12/12 (timeout 0, notApplicable 3)": three mutants on the def and on each method but __init__ (the classmethod and the async method included), callRemoval killed at a statement-level call site and notApplicable with none, the TestStrengthReport v1 shape unchanged, the project tree byte-identical, and a project-root json.py and ast.py that leave a marker when imported never imported (no marker afterwards); and src/config.py#Config.lookup names that one method
